title: About me
bio: I'm a Senior Product Designer shipping end-to-end B2B/B2C SaaS platforms, scalable design systems, and trustworthy AI workflows, combining user research, systems thinking, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility. Previously AI UX at Microsoft and Level Access, I'm currently building AI-native React and WCAG 2.2 AA prototypes with Cursor and Claude Code.
Thanks for taking the time to get to know me. I look forward to connecting!

focus.heading: My focus
focus.body: In two words: tech and people. I strongly believe that technology should be as invisible as possible, working to enhance lives. That’s why I majored in industrial design, where I was eager to create consumer electronics, but eventually found my way into UX & UI design and fell in love with it. That’s where I realized the lasting impact that I can have through technology and software.

items.title: Good design
items.description: I am a firm believer of Dieter Rams' 10 principles for good design, and they are specially important with products in the digital age.

items.title: Nature
items.description: I am one of those “Let’s go for a walk in nature” type of person, I love cold weather, dipping my feet in a river and feeling a morning breeze.

items.title: Movies
items.description: Have you ever watched “The Secret Life of Walter Mitty”? I love talking about movies, composition, directors, scripts and how impactful a story can be.

items.title: Philosophy
items.description: I’m a big fan of Marcus Aurelius' “Meditations” so I consider myself a student of stoicism, but most importantly, I believe the way is just to keep learning, acknowledging that we are all just students.

items.title: Food
items.description: You'll always hear me say "Let's grab a bite", and my favorite thing to do is go out for brunch and coffee.

items.title: Family
items.description: I'm always looking forward to hanging out with my family, my partner and my dogs, I will bring them anywhere I can.
